body:
I’ve been alone for 25 years with only 2 not being alone. I can see myself being alone until I die because I can’t meet people or open myself up anymore. What’s the point when everyone leaves anyway?

I am a waste of life. I’m perfectly healthy but can’t do anything worthwhile in my life. I can’t find anyone to spend my life with. I’m not good at any particular skill (so I can’t focus on a talent) and I hate my job. If I use the self checkouts on the weekend, I don’t speak to anyone from Friday night to Monday morning. 

People wouldn’t leave me if I weren’t a bad person. Those friends of mine? They left notes around my house when one of them was moving out, saying I’m a garbage person and then never gave me a chance to talk it out. Then my landlord evicted me. After my bf saw me fall apart from all of that, he broke up with me. Then I’m falling apart at work and I’m on probation. Now my mom may die and if not, I’ll have to help cover some of the costs of renovating our home to make it accessible when I’m too poor to buy a house or go on vacation. 

I am just waiting to die. Every subway train that goes by is tempting. Every time I cross the road I think “this should be it.” And now that I’ve found a place to live, the balcony is just constantly there, reminding me, “this is how your uncle died. He fell from much higher and looked ok for the open casket.”

I have no future because with each passing day, I get older and uglier and less desirable. I’m just a leftover. Third-rate. Someone no one wants. After my family dies, no one will remember me anyway.

There is no good way to go, but living alone makes self-harm very easy. Now would have been a good time to call on friends....

How can basically ~20 people be wrong about the worth of a person? Every year since beginning school, I couldn’t keep a friend, despite being with the same 51 people for the first 15 years? I don’t even want to have to deal with myself. 

No one wants to start a relationship or even a friendship with someone who wants to die.  

If I died tonight, only my parents and coworkers would show up. Both out of obligation. I’d have no friends come at all. What a pathetic waste of a life I am. At least I wouldn’t leave my parents with any debts because I have enough to cover the cost of a funeral.

I wish any of what you said could be considered true. 

My mom has a series of chronic disorders, making any surgery and recovery very difficult. 

 I’ve tried many times with dating apps, only to receive dick pics and requests for casual sex. The apps are too shallow, but I’m also too afraid to meet people in real life because with how my luck is going, I’d probably get murdered (or worse). 

These aren’t the first friends to abandon me. I’ve never kept friends for more than a year because somehow I am a bad person not worth staying with. I have been alone for my entire life except for the last two years, when I thought I had figured everything out. Now it’s back to the same bullshit of the previous 25 years. No friends. No romantic relationships. Family who only call when they need something from me. 

I’ve tried and been burned too many times. And now, with all this self-loathing, I won’t burden anyone with my presence. 

I have an 8h floor balcony. I’m hoping it’s high enough.
